# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with major font and lifecycle updates. It rolls up variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, SKPathBuilder, explicit surface sampling, broader native assets, and corrected singleton ownership. This is a breaking release: review the API, font, stream, WebAssembly, and Vulkan migrations before upgrading from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy paint, font, sampling, and run-buffer APIs are compile errors** — Pre-v4 obsolete APIs are removed from the reference surface. Move SKPaint text state to SKFont, use SKSamplingOptions instead of SKFilterQuality, use SKFontHinting, and replace run-buffer Get*Span methods with the Glyphs and Positions properties. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo moves to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update references to the correctly cased type; the old type no longer provides IEquatable, Equals, or equality operators. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — Derived wrappers can no longer assign IgnorePublicDispose after construction. Set disposal protection through the appropriate constructor path instead. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface** — new SKFont() and assigning a null typeface now produce SKTypeface.Empty, so text measures to zero and draws nothing. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default or another explicit typeface, and use IsEmpty to detect an unset face. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint and missing-family typeface null semantics change** — A new SKPaint exposes SKTypeface.Default instead of null, and SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns the default face when no family matches. Use IsEmpty for paint checks and SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when strict null-on-miss behavior is required. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) validates the 32-bit native range** — The long overload is obsolete and now throws OverflowException for values outside Int32 instead of silently truncating them. Validate the offset and call Move(int). ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Ganesh Vulkan requires Vulkan 1.1** — Creating a Ganesh context with Vulkan 1.0 can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the instance for Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the matching value; use another backend on 1.0-only hardware.
- **Vulkan backend interop layouts change** — GRVkBackendContextNative removes fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2. GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo also gains Components, so update manual layout assumptions. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Assembly version advances to 4.148.0.0** — SkiaSharp.dll moves from assembly version 3.119.0.0 to 4.148.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks pinned to the 3.x assembly version. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m148** — The bundled engine adds newer codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, color-aware filters, and the RF16 single-channel half-float color type. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **SKPathBuilder becomes the path construction API** — SKPathBuilder wraps Skia's immutable-path model, while existing SKPath mutation methods remain available with obsolete warnings for migration. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Upstream m147 correctness fixes** — Same-milestone syncs correct SkRP optimizer accounting, improve SkRuntimeEffect thread safety, and reject malformed SkRegion data. ([#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for variation axes, named instances, design coordinates, palette selection, and per-color overrides. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and stream-backed SKData** — SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData returns backing SKData when a stream can expose it without copying. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Explicit sampling for surface and bitmap draws** — New overloads accept SKSamplingOptions for SKSurface.Draw, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs** — Adds SKDocument.CreateXps options, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and additional HDR color types. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor the actual row stride** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now calculate lengths and coordinates from RowBytes, returning correct pixels for non-square and shared-buffer subsets. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **SKPath finalization no longer depends on builder collection order** — Disposal avoids flushing a builder after finalization has begun, preventing a native crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches** — Reattached GL views retain their dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface that remains blank. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **WinUI projection loading works for .NET 9** — The projection assembly is packaged under both current and previous Windows target frameworks so .NET 9 applications can resolve it. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton initialization and ownership are corrected** — Process-wide wrappers initialize lazily without constructor cycles, no longer free shared native objects, and remain alive across native calls. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility checks run on first interop use** — The compatibility gate moves from module load to the SkiaApi type initializer, allowing applications to configure native-library resolution before the first call. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets** — Native packages add linux-bionic x64 and arm64 assets plus tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 support. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload** — Apple NuGet assets target 26.0 rather than 26.2, allowing consumers to build with any compatible Xcode 26 workload. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WebAssembly native support starts at .NET 8** — The packages retain Emscripten assets for .NET 8 and later and report a clear build error on unsupported .NET 6 and .NET 7 projects. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **libexpat receives upstream security hardening** — The bundled XML parser advances to 2.8.1 with upstream security hardening and updated entropy-source handling. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 updates the bundled shaping engine from 8.3.1.5 with improved OpenType shaping, CFF2 subsetting, and font-table handling, while adding variable-font, color-palette, and HBColor APIs.
